title: Legend item wrapping size should be more dynamic

complexity.rationale: The measured-max-label-width column calculation is already ported and working identically in vega-spec-builder-s2/src/legend/legendUtils.ts:76-84 (confirmed by direct comparison against the s1 file) — this was an internal fix, not a reviewed design decision, so nothing new needs to be built. Only a design review sign-off is outstanding, not implementation work; scored 2 rather than 1 since that review could still come back asking for a different column-count strategy for S2's legend design language.

summary: Legend items used to render in fewer columns than available horizontal space allowed because column count was computed from a fixed 220px-per-item divisor that ignored actual label content and the configured `labelLimit`. The measured-max-label-width fix already exists identically in both s1 and s2 code — but it was applied as an internal bug fix, not vetted through a design review for S2's legend behavior specifically. This spec is pending that design review before the S2 behavior can be considered finalized.
symptom: Legend items sometimes rendered in a single column despite horizontal space and `direction: "horizontal"` being available, because the column-count calculation used a fixed per-item width divisor unrelated to the real label content.
rootCause: `getColumns` (packages/vega-spec-builder/src/legend/legendUtils.ts:76-84, identically in packages/vega-spec-builder-s2/src/legend/legendUtils.ts:76-84) no longer divides available width by a fixed 220px constant. It reads a measured max label width from a dedicated `${name}_maxLabelWidth` data source added in `addData` (packages/vega-spec-builder/src/legend/legendSpecBuilder.ts:307-330), which runs `getLabelWidth(datum.displayLabel, 'normal', 14)` over every aggregated legend entry and takes the max. Columns are then `floor(width / (min(maxLabelWidth, labelLimit ?? DEFAULT_LEGEND_LABEL_LIMIT) + symbolAndSpacingWidth))`, where `DEFAULT_LEGEND_LABEL_LIMIT` is 184px (packages/constants/constants.ts:115) — the same default the issue references — used only as a fallback when no measured width exists. The original hardcoded-220 defect was fixed by commit 6d353ab10 ("fix: legend columns account for actual label size rather than just using labelLimit") and further built on by the later `_preferredColumns` dynamic column-layout feature.

comparison.aspect: Column count computation for horizontal legends
comparison.expected: Column count reflects actual label content and the configured `labelLimit`, not a fixed per-item width.
comparison.actual: Current code does this via the `${name}_maxLabelWidth` measured-width data source; the fixed `floor(width / 220)` divisor described in the issue no longer exists in either package.

crossCutting.notes: s2 already carries the identical measured-max-label-width fix as s1 (verified byte-for-byte equivalent logic in packages/vega-spec-builder-s2/src/legend/legendUtils.ts:76-84), but this was ported as an internal bug fix rather than reviewed as the intended S2 legend column-layout design. Pending design review to confirm this is the final behavior for S2 (vs. a different column-count strategy that fits S2's design language).

implementationPlan.change: Reference precedent only — `getColumns` computes columns from the measured max label width (`${name}_maxLabelWidth`) capped at `labelLimit`, not a fixed 220px divisor.
Reference precedent only — adds the `${name}_maxLabelWidth` data source that `getColumns` reads from.
Already carries the identical measured-width fix. Pending: design review sign-off that this is the intended final S2 behavior. If review requests a different approach, this is the file to change.

openQuestions: Is the measured-max-label-width column calculation (already ported from s1) the design-approved final behavior for S2 legends, or does S2's legend design call for a different column-count strategy? Needs design review sign-off before this can move to implemented.
